svg.title: Representative image and cell computations read and write their own datasets
svg.desc: The Python coordinator dispatches compact task descriptions to three representative operations. Python spectral fitting directly reads source bands and writes a component-image pyramid. QuPath/JVM segmentation and measurement directly read that component image and write cell IDs, cell/nucleus geometry and measurement values. Python marker fitting reads the selected measurements and writes keyed marker states. Dashed arrows carry task requests; blue arrows carry direct dataset reads and teal arrows writes. The coordinator does not carry these image or cell arrays. Matrices, geometry, histogram and table rows are schematic. Other model branches are omitted.
